# Cibrán Docampo — Personal Site

> Senior Software Developer (backend focus) based in Cangas, Galicia, Spain.
> Telecommunications Engineer with over a decade building software across IPTV and video
> streaming, digital signage, maritime surveillance, e-health, food delivery and large-scale
> observability platforms.

## About

Cibrán Docampo Piñeiro is a Telecommunications Engineer and Senior Backend Developer.
His work focuses on data at scale, complex third-party integrations and the platforms that
hold them together. He works in small, high-performance squads of 2–3 engineers (shared
analysis and design, cross code reviews, close coordination with infrastructure and product
teams) and uses an AI-native engineering workflow: brainstorming and planning with AI,
development with Claude Code and a QA gate before every merge, supported by custom skills,
slash commands, sub-agents and MCP integrations. AI accelerates; the team designs and
validates.

## Core strengths

- Big Data at scale: software that ingests, stores and exploits massive event volumes
  (billions of events per day); data modelling, analytical (columnar/OLAP) databases,
  materialised views and pre-aggregations to keep queries fast, flexible and cost-efficient.
- Complex integrations: heterogeneous third-party systems with different protocols,
  formats and latencies in 24/7 high-availability, real-time environments, including a
  custom-built ESB when existing tools did not meet the needs.
- Architecture and cloud: serverless, event-driven solutions on AWS and platforms
  deployed on Kubernetes, in coordination with infrastructure/DevOps teams.
- High performance: from C++ close to the hardware to asynchronous APIs serving millions
  of devices.
- Full lifecycle: requirements, architecture, development, deployment, production
  operations and critical incident resolution.
- LLM integration: natural-language questions turned into safe, validated SQL queries.

## Core expertise

- Backend: Python, FastAPI, Celery, Flask, Django/DRF, Node.js, C/C++, Java
- Data & Databases: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, DynamoDB, Redis, InfluxDB, time-series databases
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, SQS/SNS), Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Keycloak
- Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, ELK Stack, CloudWatch, Loki
- AI: LLM integration, Claude Code, AI-assisted software engineering
- Multimedia & AV: FFmpeg, HW/SW transcoding, DVB/IPTV, HLS/DASH streaming
- Frontend: Vue.js, React, Astro

## Career highlights

- Senior Backend Developer at Plexus Tech (2022–present):
  - Obsly (2025–present): multi-tenant SaaS observability and UX analytics platform for web
    and mobile apps, processing billions of events per day. Elasticsearch → ClickHouse
    migration (materialised views, pre-aggregations, sharding) for more performance and
    flexibility at lower infrastructure cost; large-scale analytics; LLM natural-language
    to SQL; alerting and multi-channel notifications; SSO/RBAC; Kubernetes and CI/CD.
  - WinDelivery by Glovo (2022–2025), as Integration Tech Lead: food delivery integration
    platform connecting restaurant groups RB Iberia (Burger King, Popeyes), ALSEA (VIPS,
    Foster's Hollywood, Ginos), FDB (Telepizza) and NRSur (Dunkin' Donuts) with POS systems,
    delivery aggregators and last-mile logistics — tens of millions of orders. Custom ESB in
    plain Python, serverless event-driven AWS architecture, production operations.
  - Savia — MAPFRE (2022), full stack: redesign of MAPFRE's health insurance and e-health
    platform towards a modular, multi-vertical architecture (Django, Django Oscar, DRF,
    Stripe, Celery).
- Senior Backend Developer at Optiva Media (2021–2022): device management for Movistar+
  set-top boxes and OTT players in Spain and Latin America (channel lists, permissions,
  updates); legacy multicast tooling migrated to dockerised, monitored C++, and the first
  steps of a single async Python (Sanic) device management platform.
- Full Stack Developer at Grupo CPS (2021): real-time integration of AIS feeds, SIVE
  radar networks and FIWARE/Orion Context Broker for national security agencies;
  event-driven Redis Streams pipelines for low-connectivity border surveillance environments.
- Multimedia & AV Engineering at TRISON (2018–2021): designed innovative AV solutions for
  interactive retail spaces, touch-sensitive floors in shopping centres, and VR/AR
  experiences for car dealerships worldwide (Porsche, Inditex, Ecoalf, Baleària, AENA).
- Full Stack Developer at Arantia/Televes (2013–2018): professional IPTV headend and
  hardware/software transcoding and streaming products.

## Personal projects

Open source projects on [GitHub](https://github.com/cibrandocampo) and [Docker Hub](https://hub.docker.com/u/cibrandocampo).

### Nudge

A gentle reminder app for recurring things — groceries, medications, filters, anything
you tend to forget. Full-stack PWA with push notifications, sharing, and offline support.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/cibrandocampo/nudge)
- [Live site](https://nudge.cibran.es)

### OVH DynDNS Client

Lightweight DynDNS client for OVH domains. Keeps your DNS record in sync with your
dynamic public IP — perfect for self-hosted setups behind a residential connection.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/cibrandocampo/ovh-dyndns-client)
- [Live site](https://ovh-dyndns.cibran.es)

### Synology Video Enhancer

Transcoding optimisation tool for Synology Photos. Automatically re-encodes videos to
H.264 High Profile or H.265/HEVC, fixing the quality issues of Synology's default
mobile transcoding pipeline.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/cibrandocampo/synology-photos-video-enhancer)
- [Live site](https://video-enhancer.cibran.es)

### YourFisio

Physiotherapy management platform developed at Stickybit. Patient tracking, session
scheduling and exercise prescription for clinics.

- [Live site](https://yourfisio.com)

### CarbWise

Carbohydrate calculator built to help people with diabetes manage their diet. Look up
carb values from official sources and calculate insulin doses — simple, fast and
mobile-first.

- [GitHub](https://github.com/cibrandocampo/carbwise)
- [Live site](https://carbwise.cibran.es)

### eBird Life List

Bird sightings logged on eBird — Cornell Lab's global citizen science platform.
214 species logged to date.

- [My eBird profile](https://ebird.org/profile/OTIxNTk2OA/world)

### HappyWhale

380+ whale encounters logged, 56 uniquely identified on HappyWhale — a global cetacean
research database. Fin whales and humpbacks off the Galician coast.

- [My HappyWhale profile](https://happywhale.com/user/25322)

### Lego Builder

A personal experiment — image recognition tool that identifies Lego bricks and suggests
possible builds. Because why not?
